decision_rationale: This is a post-training method applied to existing LLM backbones, not a new foundational model architecture. The record still shows generative use and broad biomedical applicability, but the candidate contribution is a wrapper/alignment layer over existing models.
evidence_snippet: "prompting it to generate a response"; "BFT-aligned LLMs produce more accurate and professional biomedical profile texts"; "broad biological knowledge"; "replacing the default closed-source backbones"; "application_boundary":"wrapper_boundary"
